name: Easy Chicken Stir-Fry
directions: Slice the chicken into bite-size pieces; cut the broccoli into florets and the bell pepper into strips. Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Cook the chicken 5-6 minutes until browned and cooked through, then set aside. Stir-fry the broccoli and bell pepper for 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender. Add minced garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds. Return the chicken to the pan, add soy sauce, and toss until heated through. Serve hot over rice.
